overview:
①今日优先处理：CVE-2026-123198（LMDB render_knowl SSTI，CVSS 9.8，未认证可利用）——若栈内有 LMFDB 需立即升级到 commit 01829bd 或之后；同时检查 Black GitHub Action 是否用 use_pyproject: true（CVE-2026-114134，8.7），这是 CI 供应链风险。

②趋势留意：Python 生态核心包连环出事（h5io 反序列化、PyMoDAQ 反序列化、hashlib FIPS 回归），且多个漏洞集中在反序列化和代码注入类；另有 CISA 新增两个已被利用漏洞进目录、OpenSSH+musl 密码认证绕过，说明攻击面正从应用层扩展到基础设施与供应链。

③风险提示：条目中多起漏洞（尤其反序列化类）只需攻击者提供恶意文件或输入即可触发，切勿在未核实依赖版本前 assumption「内部环境打不到」，先盘点版本再评估暴露面。

sideline.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants
sideline.summary: Cloudflare mitigated over 8,200 DDoS attacks per hour in Q3 2026 as attackers shifted to shorter, high-frequency strikes. Explore the latest threat data, including the collapse of CLDAP vectors and the impact of recent botnet takedowns.

sideline.title: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge
sideline.summary: We are launching a PHP Capture the Flag challenge integrated with our Bug Bounty program to test our WAF protections. Security researchers are invited to bypass our defenses and capture the flag to help make the Internet safer.
